            // Olaf Schmalfuß, born 1980, Master of
            Arts (M.A.) in Library and Information Science, as
            well as German Linguistics at the
            Humboldt-University Berlin, a Librarian by passion
            and profession and Data Quality Evangelist and Ambassador,
            has been working at De
            Gruyter Verlag in Berlin since 2012.
            Initially as manager and technical contact for key accounts
            of the Technical Customer Service, since 2015 he
            has been responsible for data governance in the domains of
            Product Information Management (PIM) and
            business partners, as well as data
            warehousing and metadata development/delivery,
            amongst other things, with an even stronger focus on
            master data and metadata in “Business
            Process Management” then “Product Data, Metadata &
            Standards”.
            Before that, he gained experience in various positions in
            the book trade and at the MPIWG
            library.
